summary: Household: Nevada, four people (married couple plus children; the children's count was unclear but doesn't change the result). Household earnings are about $1.1 million a year from work. None of the ten programmes fit. SNAP, WIC, TANF, SSI, Medicaid, CHIP, school meals, and the ACA premium tax credit are all income-tested and far above their limits. EITC is far above its phase-out. The refundable child tax credit is fully phased out at this income (the phase-out for married couples starts at $400,000). No programme is recommended. If the income figure was meant to be a different amount, such as $1,100 a month, please tell me and I will re-screen.
